Canonical PlaceId/PortraitId and Position<Scene> distinguish presentation identity from native Entity/render-layer ordinal; CharacterId(person.id.0) is explicit durable-character projection, supporting F040 common CharacterId owner. retained-strategic-presentation.disposition: meaningful renderer authority boundary; canonical identity projection and native render state
